final.summary: One comparable prior decision judged the code not exploitable for a reason specific to it. Another retrieved issue is a performance fix and is not a security precedent.

precedents.title: redirect_to uses the return_to parameter in the archived service
precedents.rationale: Reviewers found the input constrained before use.
precedents.quote: Not exploitable: return_to is replaced by a stored session value before the redirect.

caveats: Issue 7673 matched on vocabulary only; it is a performance issue.
